During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''[[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]''' had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on their head. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] tracked the Sullustan down and captured the them alive, restraining them with [[Stuncuffs/Legends|binders]]. The Sullustan had light skin with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dressed in an orange shirt with blue vest.<ref name="Captured" />
